name: Viyash Scientific Ltd
title: Viyash Scientific Ltd - 512529 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 EBITDA crossed INR200 crore (21.7% margin) on merger synergies, but capital-cycle signals are thin: no capacity cut, management plans R&D and capex build and quotes INR800 crore FY27/28 EBITDA-style targets loosely.

capex.quote: we gave capex clearance for R&D on the company. People, we started hiring. And most important manufacturing infrastructure also we are adding this year.

triggers.label: Synergies INR50-60 cr annualised
triggers.quote: we are accruing close to what you mentioned, INR50 crores, INR60 crores

triggers.label: Price hikes offset solvent and freight
triggers.quote: And another area, we are trying to increase the prices.

triggers.label: Receivables days up ~5-6 days
triggers.quote: maybe about 5, 6 days of increase that we have seen in Q4

guidance.quote: Average tax rate should be around 27%.

guidance.value: grow 40% in FY27 from INR200-225 crore base
guidance.quote: FY27, I can say, at least innovative business on this life cycle management, I am expecting to grow 40%

red_flags.label: EBITDA-to-PAT conversion weak; receivables outpacing revenue
red_flags.quote: how can we convert into EBITDA to PAT better

red_flags.label: Targets loosely framed and shifting
red_flags.quote: Don't take it -- maybe 29% or whatever it is.

evasions.quote: Somebody says FY28, somebody says ‘FY28 but ‘FY27, my internal target was FY27.
But the first one, NCG, it takes time to be done.
